title: Target quotient restriction is projection change-of-scalars
statement: For the constant-completion coefficient data, whiskering the finite coefficient comparison on the target site by pullback along completedMap identifies the target quotient restriction with change of scalars along the target projection.

proof.text: Apply finiteComparison on J' at level n and whisker its natural isomorphism on the left by pull F (completedMap F A I).

lean.statement: theorem ordinaryReducedPull_targetQuotientIso (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) : Nonempty ((pull F (completedMap F A I) ⋙ res (coefficientMap J' A I) ⋙ change (quotient J' A I n)) ≅ (pull F (completedMap F A I) ⋙ change (projection J' A I n)))
